criterion_text: After the staged cutover, the proprietary `/images/blobs/{digest}` route is unavailable to migrated clients; standard `/v2/` still serves approved complete closures, denies wrong principal/repository/forged digest and preserves persistent Agent cache and active mounts. A staged rollback/protected compatibility toggle restores only explicitly supported clients without bypassing authorization.

verifiers.summary: SC-03: the proprietary route is unavailable to migrated clients, /v2/ serves approved closures and denies wrong principal/repository/forged digest, cache and mounts are preserved, and the protected toggle restores only supported legacy clients without bypassing authorization
